This paper is about motion retrieval for character control through reinforcement learning. It does not involve a language model conditioning its output on retrieved text documents. Retrieved items are motion experts, not text, and the controller is not a language model generator. Under the rules, this is not RAG in the defined sense, so E1 applies (retrieval without a language-model generator conditioning on retrieved text). E9 (multimodal-only RAG) is a possible alternative, but E1 fits better.
